inputs_read: directing/ep01/storyboard.json (draft - situations only; shot list and group split not treated as final)
key_decisions: CLOSED LENS SET. Three working primes carry 95 % of ep01: 28 mm (space and bulk), 40 mm (the human-eye lens: travel, POV, two-plane inserts), 50 mm (faces, hands, hero objects). Two focal lengths are rationed - 24 mm twice, on the episode's two purely vertical scale axes (up the table leg in S06, down her own body in S07), and 100 mm once, on the garden POV in S05. The waking frame is shot on 28/40/50 only, so the lens itself separates the registers the way ornament does in CR-014.

FOCAL LENGTHS ARE 35 mm FULL-FRAME EQUIVALENTS, written into prompts verbatim. style.json's 'anamorphic' is ruled to be a FINISH word (oval highlights, faint horizontal flare, halation), never a field-of-view conversion - otherwise every downstream station guesses differently.

SCALE IS CARRIED BY HEIGHT + GAUGE + FOCAL, and the mapping is stated per scale state: 1.35 m normal (lens 1.20-1.35 in the dream, 40 mm default); 0.254 m ten inches (lens 0.15-0.25, 28 mm default with a known-size gauge inside 0.3 m of the lens); 2.74 m giant (lens 0.30-1.00 and never above, 28 mm fragments that overflow the frame while the far end of the hall stays small in the same image); 0.61 m two feet (lens 0.50-0.60 dry / 0.05-0.15 at the waterline, 40 mm to repeat the S05 set-up).

HARD RULE: never a wide lens on a face at tiny scale. 50 mm at close focus for every face at every scale - a stretched child's face is exactly the 'distorted face' / cartoon failure mode style.json bans.

MINIATURE-LOOK BAN. Shallow depth of field at close range on a small subject is the signature of photographing a miniature, which would destroy the oversized-practical-set grammar (CR-005) and the photographed finish (CR-001). Every size beat is DEEP FOCUS and no gauge may be defocused; a tilt-shift / diorama / macro-blur negative addon is supplied, marked additive and subordinate to style.json's locked negative list.

MATCH-FOCAL PAIRS are named so the episode's repetitions survive parallel shot design: S05 door round / S09 run (40 mm, height 1.30 -> 0.55); S06 floor axis / S08 movement 4 (28 mm); the two S03 shaft POVs; the hook wide / the S03 recognised wide.

POV LENS RULE. Six of the seven POVs are 40 mm, the human-eye lens; the seventh, the garden, is 100 mm - the one place the camera lies about distance, which is the feeling of the scene. Keeping the other six honest is what makes that lie legible.

ACT-5 GEOMETRY MADE EXPLICIT. Her head is reachable by a water-level 50 mm in the aria only because the POSE brings it down; no long lens may reach up at her, because that puts the 2.30 m lamp line in frame and breaks color_script act 5. The last set-up allowed a lamp fixture is the S07 vault-knock.

RACK-FOCUS BUDGET ZERO for ep01. Not a revocation of CR-006 - every candidate rack here is a scale or cause-and-effect comparison needing both planes sharp, or would hero the rabbit's pass, which the plan forbids.

SUPER-RESOLUTION DISCIPLINE. Texture is specified at the scale of the frame (halation bloom, haze volume, falloff, contrast) and never at the pixel. Grain is handled by leaving it alone: style_fragment_ui already carries 'fine film grain' and is quoted verbatim in every prompt, so no shot-level grain word is permitted; a forbidden list (heavy grain, scratches, gate weave, chromatic aberration, 8K/ultra-sharp, blue streak flare) is supplied.

notes: The spec is written against the storyboard DRAFT and does not depend on the H3S signature: every rule is keyed to a situation (a scale state, a POV, a lettering insert, a water-level single), not to a shot number, so a re-cut or a re-grouped storyboard does not invalidate it. Shot references are cited as evidence that the situation occurs, not as shot design.

The provisional hook S00 is covered (it shares the S03 locked-wide lens exactly, which is what the anti-repeat rule needs). If the user selects oh-2 at H3S the entry simply goes unused; nothing else in this file changes.
